name: Expenses
author: Brett
description: The Expense Tracker as a Molly module: its ledger (totals, recent entries, search) and Add entry run natively inside Molly over the Expenses API (/api/expenses/v1) with Molly's one sign-in. The standalone app at expenses.amberxai.com keeps running as it is. Removing this folder puts Expenses back to opening on its own.

items.title: List recent entries
items.description: The newest ledger entries (date, merchant, category, account, total), optionally filtered by words.

items.title: Totals
items.description: Spent, income and net over the whole ledger.

items.title: Open Expenses in Molly
items.description: Opens the ledger, or add for Add entry.

commands.noReads: no data folder: the ledger lives on the Expenses server
